query: SELECT b.id FROM whatsapp_group_binding b JOIN whatsapp_group_membership m ON m.binding_id=b.id JOIN whatsapp_group_audience v ON v.binding_id=b.id AND v.user_id=$3 JOIN comms_channel_participants cp ON cp.channel_id=b.channel_id AND cp.user_id=$3 JOIN team_user tu ON tu.team_id=b.team_id AND tu.user_id=$3 WHERE b.group_jid=$1 AND m.account_id=$2 AND m.consent_ended_at IS NULL AND m.authorization_generation=$4 AND v.revoked_at IS NULL AND cp.left_at IS NULL FOR SHARE OF b,m,v,cp,tu
